observations.statement: Poki states that non-localized text-based games struggle in countries they are not localized for.
observations.excerpt: For the Poki audience, as we are worldwide, non-localized text based games struggle in countries not localized so it's really important to think this through when creating your game!

observations.statement: Poki recommends EFIGS plus Turkish as the first localization batch (a recommendation, not a requirement).
observations.excerpt: EFIGS (English, French, Italian, German, Spanish): the broad base across Europe and the Americas. We recommend adding Turkish to this first batch; it's an increasingly popular locale.

observations.statement: Poki names clicker and idle games among the genres where localization pays off most.
observations.excerpt: Genres where localization pays off most: story games, clicker and idle games, quiz games, and anything where mechanics, items, or powerups are explained through text.
